buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) 1) ​1) Quantity : The total required quantity is 3600 Thermal Coated Paper Rolls, as per specification m entioned in the GeM bid (55 gsm, 79 mm & 50 meter). 2) Surface Smoothness & Print head Safety : The printing surface must be absolutely smooth an d dust-free to prevent abrasions or damage to the thermal print head, ensuring frictionless move ment.

3) Advance Sample : The L1 bidder shall submit sample roll (2 to 5 rolls) as an advance sample to the Bu yer for inspection and approval. Sample rolls will not be returned. 4) Sample Approval Before Bulk Supply : The successful bidder shall not commence bulk supply until t he advance sample has been inspected and approved by the Buyer/Inspection Committee. The bulk quanti ty supplied shall conform in all respects to the approved sample and the specification stipulated in the Ge M bid. 5) Conformity of Bulk Supply : The Buyer reserves the right to inspect the supplied material at the time of delivery. The entire bulk supply shall be of the same make/brand, specifications, quality and char acteristics as the approved advance sample. Any material found not conforming to the approved sa mple or bid specifications may be rejected. 6) Condition and Appearance : The Thermal Coated Paper Rolls supplied shall be new, unused, unble mished and free from any visible defects, damage, moisture, stains, wrinkles, torn sheets or o ther physical imperfections. The packing shall also be intact and suitable for safe transportation and st orage. 7) Packaging & Safety : Each roll shall be properly packed in its original/manufacturer’s packagin g, wherever applicable, so as to protect the roll from moisture, dust, physical damage and deterio ration during transportation and storage. 8) Joint-Free Requirement : The entire specified length of the roll must be continuous without a ny tape, glue, or cello joints. 9) Delivery : The successful bidder shall deliver the complete ordered quantity within the delivery perio d specified in the GeM Contract. Delivery shall be made at the designated premises of the Buyer during w orking hours or as otherwise instructed by the Buyer. 10) Inspection and Acceptance : The material shall be subject to inspection by the Buyer/Inspectio n Committee. Acceptance shall be based on conformity with the GeM bid specifications, approved advanc e sample, quantity and physical condition. 11) Unloading at Consignee’s Premises : Unloading of the material at the Buyer’s/Consignee’s premises shall be entirely the responsibility of the successful bidder. The quoted price shall be i nclusive of all expenses towards transportation, loading, unloading, handling and delivery up to the design ated delivery point. No additional charges shall be payable by the Buyer on this account. 12) Supply should have ¾ of the shelf life. 13) Replacement of Defective Batches: In case the rolls found to have poor thermal sensitivity , jamming issues or premature fading within a specified warranty/shelf-life period, the Buyer shall have the right to reject such quantity and require its free-replacement by the successful bidder. 14) Rejection of Non-Conforming Material : In case any quantity is found defective, damaged, unble mished condition is not maintained, not maintained mentioned specification or otherwise not conforming t o the approved sample/specification, the Buyer shall have the right to reject such quantity and require its r eplacement by the successful bidder at no additional cost to the Buyer. 15) General : The bidder shall be deemed to have considered all cost incidental to compliance with thes e Special Terms & Conditions while quoting the bid price. No additional payment shall be admissible for co mpliance with these conditions. 16) Bidder must submit PDF of GST Registration certificate. 17) The bidder has to submit certificate stating compliance to the specification of all the terms and conditi ons of the bid including ATC. 18) Bidder must submit Mill Test Certificate issued within six month. Current certificate must be submitte d by the L1 bidder at the time of delivery. 19) BPA free certificate for NABL Lab issued within six month of tender. Current certificate must be submi tted by the L1 bidder at the time of delivery. 20) Bidder required to submit a meter length undertaking. 21) Hybrid pre bid meeting [both online & off-line] to be held on 5th day of November, 2026 at 11:30 a.m. i

n the Chamber of Dy. Medical Superintendent, of ESIC Hospital and Medical College, Joka, Kolkata. Indentin g participants may appear physically or join the virtual meeting through the link "https://meet.google.com/ pih-onqe-snn".
